items.title: Fever’s late-game execution costly in stunning OT loss to Aces
items.body_excerpt: The Indiana Fever had every opportunity to put this one away. More than once. First, the chance to deliver a knock-out blow in the first half. Then, all they needed to do was hold on late. Instead, a series of costly mistakes and two game-altering 3-pointers from veteran guard…
